newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada invests C$60 mln in Rhone-Poulenc.
newsitem.headline: Canada invests C$60 mln in Rhone-Poulenc.

text.p: The Canadian government said on Wednesday it would invest C$60 million in Pasteur Merieux Connaught Canada, a unit of the French company Rhone-Poulenc SA.
The repayable investment was through the government's Technology Partnerships program to invest in high-technology job creation.

Under the program, Pasteur Merieux Connaught was expected to invest up to C$350 million over 10 years in a new cancer vaccine project that could create up to 300 direct jobs and an additional 250 jobs in related positions, the government said.
Repayment of the government funding would be through royalties tied to product sales, expected to be as much as C$10 billion during the first 10 years of commercialization, the government said.
